after_party = Liberal Democrats (UK, 2025) }} The '''2026 Winchester City Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect 15 of 32 members of [[Winchester City Council]] in [[Hampshire]], [[England]].{{Cite web|title=Elections should go ahead - unanimous agreement|url=https://www.winchester.gov.uk/news/2026/jan/elections-should-go-ahead-unanimous-agreement|website=Winchester City Council|date=2026-01-15|access-date=2026-01-30}}{{Cite web|title=Voters across Hampshire will head to the polls as local elections set to go ahead|url=https://www.hampshirechronicle.co.uk/news/25787917.elections-across-hampshire-set-go-ahead/|website=Hampshire Chronicle|date=2026-01-22|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en}}The council was under Liberal Democrat majority control prior to the election; their majority increased to 31 at this election. Due to ongoing [[Upcoming structural changes to local government in England|local government reorganisation]], this election is planned to be the final election to Winchester City Council before it is abolished and [[Upcoming structural changes to local government in England|replaced by a successor]] [[unitary authority]], [[Mid Hampshire Council]].
